effect: Charging the battery completed the night-readiness goal and revealed that its fuel-cell backup can sustain essential systems during a dark spell.

mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the antenna was most worthwhile because the delayed voice made the distance from Earth tangible and opened a connection to Mara.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the reflective quilt stock was straightforward and had little to say on its own, though installing it gave the result a satisfying practical detail.

surprise.text: The twelve-minute-old message made the communication delay feel real, and the battery's supplied fuel-cell backup added a detail I hadn't anticipated.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the combinations had clear practical purposes, although charging the battery was the only available combination at that point.

continue.text: I would continue to hear Mara's later reply and see how the expedition develops; the radio passage made me curious about the story.
